name: Sound effect
desc: One sound, dry, to sit under picture.

fields.label: The sound
fields.default: a single heavy low thud with a short tail, dry, no reverb
fields.hint: ONE sound per generation - the model cannot layer. Describe it physically: what hits what, how hard, how long it rings.

fields.label: Seconds
fields.hint: Lands about 30ms short of what you ask for.

post: normalise to -20 LUFS / -3 dBTP - at cfg 7 the raw output clips
note: 100 steps and cfg 7 are measured settings, not defaults. It was previously run at 8 steps / cfg 1 / lcm and the results were unusable.

evidence.method: nothing has checked this card against pixels
